definitions.condition_ci: two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval for the mean
definitions.paired_difference: coupled decay minus no decay in percentage points
definitions.paired_ci: two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval for the matched mean difference
definitions.paired_test: two-sided exact sign-flip randomization test on the matched mean difference
definitions.static_rag_defer: the model finalizes every non-abstaining proposal and the initially assigned human answers on abstention
definitions.controller_comparison: static RAG-with-defer error minus iRAG final-decision error on the same realised retrieval trajectory
definitions.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment across four primary metrics within each paired contrast; baseline and controller comparisons are adjusted across the eight paper conditions
